note: Copied from GSA's listing; verify before publishing.
format: Scraped from the page HTML (no CSV/JSON/API offered; page footer reads 'Reviewed/Updated: August 2026'). One entry per agency/component/subcomponent block. 'name' is the h2 department (or h3 small/independent agency) heading exactly as shown; 'component' is the h3 under a department ('Agencywide' blocks are stored with component null); 'subcomponent' is a bulleted bold item or h4 under a component; 'includes' lists bulleted sub-agencies shown under a block with no PM of their own; 'group' is the page section. Whitespace (tabs/double spaces) in names was collapsed to single spaces; spelling otherwise untouched. 'email' is the mailto href; 'emailAsDisplayed' appears only where the link text differs. The page shows no phone numbers, so every phone is null. Some 'managers' are shared mailboxes/helpdesks, listed as the page lists them.
extractionNotes: Department of Education (ED), Office of Personnel Management (OPM), and several components (USDA IFSB, USDA TFAA, DoW CAP, FEMA USFA) are listed with no program manager; kept with an empty managers array.
Department of Energy (DOE): 'Ilir Angjeli' and 'Yohanna Freeman (Deputy)' are listed without email addresses; only the DOE Helpdesk has an email.

USDA Research, Education and Economics (REE): ARS and NASS are bulleted without a PM; Jimmy Nazario-Negron appears inside the NIFA bullet. Stored per the HTML structure (under NIFA); he may be intended for all of REE.
Federal Law Enforcement Training Center (FLETC) appears on the page as an h4 under FEMA (DHS); stored with component FEMA as the page structures it, although FLETC is not a FEMA component.
Commerce: Charlie Franz (listed under NTIS) has an ntia.doc.gov address and Todd McKeever (listed under NTIA) has an ntis.gov address; the page may have these swapped. Copied as shown.

Several displayed names differ from the email spelling (e.g. 'Casandra Taylor' / cassandra.taylor, 'Mivrat Sewadeh' / mirvat.sewadeh, 'Lois Mockbee' / lois.mockabee, 'Audre E. Azoulas' / audre.azuolas, 'Ida Shuler' / ida.yengoyan); copied as shown.
PHMSA: mailto href is t'mia.raynor@dot.gov (straight apostrophe) while link text uses a curly apostrophe.
FERC: the displayed line ends 'jun.park@ferc.gov.' (trailing period outside the link); email recorded without it.
